messages:
maya: FYI the 2.4.1 promote is blocked, license-scan failed in postsubmit on the canary build.

maya: Scanner flagged a new transitive dep 'weird-lic' with an unclear license.

drew: ugh. did it fail the whole job or just warn?

maya: job failed, exit code 2. logfile shows 'license: UNKNOWN' for that package.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for release/2.4.1 by CI gate (license-scan failed) :warning:

julian: Can we short-circuit the gate for a canary? We could still run smoke in prod region but not promote to stable.

sara: Legal needs to sign off on any unknown licenses — pinging legal-bot. If they say no, we have to revert.

legal-bot: @sara tagged legal-review queue. ETA ~2-4 hours depending on package owner response.

maya: Options: 1) pin to previous working dep tree + rerun CI 2) temporarily skip license-scan for canary (not ideal) 3) revert the PR that introduced the dep 4) wait for legal review.

drew: Pinning sounds fastest. What's the PR?

maya: PR #4382 (adds analytics-client -> pulls weird-lic). I can open a small patch to pin analytics-client to 1.3.2 which doesn't pull weird-lic.

julian: If we pin, we should include a release-note callout and a follow-up task to re-evaluate the analytics client upgrade once legal confirms.

sara: Agree. Also we need an entry in the changelog: note the temporary pin.

drew: If maya can push the pin and CI clears, we can keep the change window today. Otherwise we should move to next window.

maya: prepping patch now. command I'll run: ```git checkout -b pin/analytics-1.3.2 && yq -i '.dependencies.analytics-client = "1.3.2"' package.yml && git commit -am "pin analytics-client to 1.3.2 to avoid unknown license" && git push origin pin/analytics-1.3.2```

deploy-bot: Noted. I will unpause promotion automatically when CI passes on main + canary.

sara: For release notes, add:
```
- Temporarily pinned analytics-client to 1.3.2 due to an unknown license flag on a transitive dependency. Follow-up legal review in progress.
```

julian: I'll own the follow-up ticket to re-evaluate the upgrade after legal clears.

legal-bot: If the package owner replies with license metadata before CI completes, tag me and I'll escalate.

maya: Patch pushed, CI re-run started. will update thread when green or if it fails. :crossed_fingers:

drew: Thanks. If CI still fails, we'll revert PR #4382 and cut notes explaining rollback.

maya: update 1749910400: CI passed on the pinned build, deploy-bot resumed promotion, canary deployed to eu-west-1. Leaving this thread open until legal confirms the transitive dep license.

sara: filing changelog + release notes now and adding legal-review ID LD-912 to the release tracking doc.

julian: action items: maya -> verify legal outcome, julian -> follow-up ticket, sara -> update release notes.

maya: closing provisional hold for now but keeping watch.
